entry.name: ZoomMin
entry.label: Smallest zoom the overview reaches (1.0 is native scale).

entry.name: ZoomStep
entry.label: Zoom factor per wheel notch.

entry.name: GridBase
entry.label: Minor grid spacing in canvas pixels.

entry.name: GridOctaveFactor
entry.label: Each coarser grid octave is this many times larger.

entry.name: GridOctaves
entry.label: Number of grid octaves drawn.

entry.name: TileImage
entry.label: Optional image tiled across the canvas at 1:1. Empty draws the grid.

entry.name: BorderActivate
entry.label: Screen edges and corners that open the canvas (written by the Screen Edges settings page). 0 top, 1 top-right, 2 right, 3 bottom-right, 4 bottom, 5 bottom-left, 6 left, 7 top-left.

entry.name: TouchBorderActivate
entry.label: Touch screen edges that open the canvas.

entry.name: HudPosition
entry.label: Where the toolbar sits on the primary display: Top, TopLeft, TopRight, Bottom, BottomLeft, BottomRight, Left, Right.

entry.name: HudShape
entry.label: Toolbar shape: auto (square in a corner, horizontal on the top or bottom edge, vertical on a side), or horizontal, vertical, square.

entry.name: OpenZoom
entry.label: View when the canvas opens: "fit" zooms to every window and frame, "1" stays at 1:1, any other number is a zoom anchored at the screen centre.

entry.name: KeyApply
entry.label: Keys that apply and close, as Qt key names without the Key_ prefix, comma separated.

entry.name: KeyHome
entry.label: Look through the current desktop's frames.

entry.name: KeyOrigin
entry.label: Camera to the canvas origin.

entry.name: KeyPan
entry.label: Held while dragging to pan from anywhere.

entry.name: MouseFocusWindow
entry.label: Gesture on a window that applies with it focused: Click or DoubleClick, with optional Shift+, Ctrl+, Alt+, Meta+.

entry.name: MouseZoomToDesktop
entry.label: Gesture on a desktop frame that zooms the camera to that desktop's frames.

entry.name: MouseGotoDesktop
entry.label: Gesture on a desktop frame that applies with that desktop current.

entry.name: MouseNewDesktopAt
entry.label: Gesture on a window outside every frame that creates a desktop centred on it.

entry.name: ToggleShortcut
entry.label: Key sequence that opens and closes the canvas.

entry.name: HomeShortcut
entry.label: Key sequence that returns to the canvas origin.

entry.name: DesktopGap
entry.label: Gap in canvas pixels between the frame groups of neighbouring virtual desktops when first laid out.

entry.name: FollowActivation
entry.label: Pan the canvas so an activated off-screen window comes on screen.

entry.name: PublishGround
entry.label: Write the ground offset to the kwin-canvas-ground wallpaper via plasmashell.

entry.name: AutoActivate
entry.label: Open the canvas as soon as the effect loads (nested test harness).

entry.name: DebugCommand
entry.label: Command executed on reconfigure when DebugSeq changes (nested test harness).
